Article 151 is specifically concerned with audit reports.
Match the following questions frequently test Articles 148 through 151 together.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 148 establishes the office of the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG).
Article 149 prescribes the duties and powers associated with the CAG.
Article 150 deals with the form of accounts of the Union and the States.
Article 151 relates to the submission and presentation of audit reports.
